get.summary: ListGroups returns cursor-paginated groups filtered by status.

post.summary:
CreateGroup creates a user group (organizational unit). Optional
parent_id builds a hierarchy. After creating, add members via
AddGroupMember and grant roles via AddGroupRole — members inherit the
group's roles for permission checks.

get.summary: GetGroup returns a group by ID.

delete.summary:
DeleteGroup removes a group. Does NOT cascade — members keep their user
records; direct user-role assignments are unaffected. Role assignments
to this group (AddGroupRole mappings) should be cleaned up first.

put.summary:
UpdateGroup updates group name and description. Parent_id change is not
supported (delete + recreate if hierarchy needs to change).

get.summary:
ListGroupMembers returns members of a group with cursor pagination,
optionally filtered by in-group role.

post.summary:
AddGroupMember adds a user to a group with an in-group role
(owner / admin / member). Invalidates the user's RBAC cache so
subsequent permission checks reflect the new group's roles.

delete.summary:
RemoveGroupMember removes a user from a group. Invalidates the user's
RBAC cache. Permissions arriving via this group's roles are dropped.

get.summary:
ListGroupRoles returns roles granted to a group.
Returns roles attached to a group (direct grants).

post.summary:
AddGroupRole grants a role to a group — every current (and future)
member inherits the role's permissions. Invalidates cache for all
current group members.

delete.summary:
RemoveGroupRole revokes a role from a group. Invalidates cache for all
current group members. Members who held this role only via this group
lose it; direct assignments (AssignRole) are unaffected.

get.summary:
GetLoginLogs returns login audit logs filtered by user_id (optional) and
success status. Cursor-paginated. Useful for security dashboards.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description:
- IDENTITY_PROVIDER_WECHAT: WeChat web OAuth (redirect-based).
 - IDENTITY_PROVIDER_ADMIN: Audit tag for CreateUser; not a login method.

get.summary: ListPermissionGroups returns cursor-paginated permission groups.

post.summary:
CreatePermissionGroup creates a named bundle of permissions (custom only).
Group membership is managed via UpdatePermissionGroup (full replace).

get.summary: GetPermissionGroup returns a permission group by ID, including its permissions.

delete.summary:
DeletePermissionGroup removes a group. Builtin groups cannot be deleted.
Invalidates caches of affected users.

put.summary:
UpdatePermissionGroup updates name/description and FULLY REPLACES the group's
permission set — pass the complete list, not deltas. Builtin groups cannot be
updated. Invalidates caches of affected users.

get.summary: ListPermissions returns cursor-paginated permissions.

post.summary:
CreatePermission adds a new resource:action permission. Custom (non-builtin)
only — builtins are seeded via migrations. Returns ErrPermissionExists if the
resource:action pair already exists.

get.summary: GetPermission returns a permission by ID.

delete.summary:
DeletePermission removes a permission. Builtin permissions cannot be deleted.
Invalidates caches of all users holding the permission via any role.

put.summary:
UpdatePermission updates resource/action/description. Builtin permissions
cannot be updated (ErrPermissionIsBuiltin). Changing resource/action on a
permission in use invalidates caches of all affected users.

get.summary: ListRoles returns cursor-paginated roles.

post.summary:
CreateRole creates a role with permissions and/or permission groups.
Permission IDs come from ListPermissions; group IDs from
ListPermissionGroups. Roles can then be assigned to users (AssignRole)
or to groups (AddGroupRole).

get.summary: GetRole returns a role by ID, including its permissions and permission groups.

delete.summary:
DeleteRole removes a role. Cascades to user/group assignments. Invalidates
cache for affected users. Builtin roles (is_builtin=true) should not be
deleted.

put.summary:
UpdateRole updates name/description and FULLY REPLACES the role's
permission and permission-group sets — pass the complete intended list,
not deltas. Invalidates the RBAC cache for all affected users.

get.summary:
ListUsers returns a cursor-paginated list of users with rich filters.
Prefer over ListUsersPaged for stable iteration under concurrent writes
(cursor pagination does not skip/dup rows when inserts happen mid-scan).
Empty next_cursor means end of result set.

parameters.name: nickname
parameters.description: nickname is matched as a prefix (LIKE 'nickname%') to leverage index.

parameters.name: registerSource
parameters.description:
- IDENTITY_PROVIDER_WECHAT: WeChat web OAuth (redirect-based).
 - IDENTITY_PROVIDER_ADMIN: Audit tag for CreateUser; not a login method.

parameters.name: registerDevice
parameters.description: - DEVICE_TYPE_API: Machine-to-machine / direct API token (no UA).

parameters.name: userType
parameters.description:
- USER_TYPE_NORMAL: External end user (default).
 - USER_TYPE_INTERNAL: Platform internal user (staff, operations, etc.).

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
Sort spec: order_by picks the column, descending flips direction.
UNSPECIFIED + descending=false is equivalent to id ascending.

 - USER_SORT_FIELD_ID: Default: snowflake id ascending.

post.summary:
CreateUser creates a user as an administrator. The new account starts in
PENDING_REVIEW status with the given password; the user activates it by
calling ChangePassword with the initial password — that flips status to
ACTIVE. No verification code is required (admin attestation).
Errors: ErrEmailExists / ErrPhoneExists / ErrUsernameExists on conflict.

get.summary:
ListUsersPaged returns offset-paginated users with optional total count.
Use for admin UIs that need page numbers + totals. Set count=false on
follow-up page loads to skip the COUNT(*) query (total/total_pages
return 0). Filters mirror ListUsers.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filters — same semantics as ListUsersRequest. Empty/zero means no filter.

parameters.name: registerSource
parameters.description:
- IDENTITY_PROVIDER_WECHAT: WeChat web OAuth (redirect-based).
 - IDENTITY_PROVIDER_ADMIN: Audit tag for CreateUser; not a login method.

parameters.name: registerDevice
parameters.description: - DEVICE_TYPE_API: Machine-to-machine / direct API token (no UA).

parameters.name: userType
parameters.description:
- USER_TYPE_NORMAL: External end user (default).
 - USER_TYPE_INTERNAL: Platform internal user (staff, operations, etc.).

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
Sort — same semantics as ListUsersRequest.

 - USER_SORT_FIELD_ID: Default: snowflake id ascending.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: when false, total/total_pages are returned as 0 (skip COUNT)

get.summary:
GetUser returns a user by ID (admin view). Same shape as GetProfile but
intended for operators, not the user themselves.

post.summary:
DisableUser toggles a user between DISABLED and ACTIVE.
Does NOT revoke sessions — call RevokeAllSessions separately if you want
immediate logout. A DISABLED user is rejected at Login time with
ErrUserDisabled.

get.summary:
ListUserRoles returns roles for a user (direct + group-inherited).
Returns direct + group-inherited roles; see UserRole.source.

post.summary:
AssignRole grants a role directly to a user. Use AddGroupRole for
group-wide permissions (members inherit). Invalidates the user's RBAC
cache.

delete.summary:
RevokeRole revokes a directly-assigned role. Does NOT revoke the same
permission arriving via a group role — call RemoveGroupRole for that.
Invalidates the user's RBAC cache.

post.summary:
Login authenticates by one of: USERNAME_PASSWORD, EMAIL_PASSWORD,
PHONE_PASSWORD, EMAIL_CODE, PHONE_CODE.
- Password methods: never auto-register; ErrIdentityNotFound if unknown.
- Code methods (EMAIL_CODE, PHONE_CODE): require a prior
  SendVerificationCode (purpose=LOGIN) with captcha_id passed through;
  auto-register when identity is missing (response.is_new=true).
Rate-limited per lookup target (5 fails / 5 min, 15 / hour).
Returns: user + session_id; is_new=true for auto-registered accounts.

Logout revokes the current session. Idempotent — empty session_id is
a no-op. To revoke other sessions (e.g. admin forcing logout), use
RevokeSession / RevokeAllSessions.

ResetPassword resets a forgotten password via verification code.
Prerequisite: SendVerificationCode with purpose=PASSWORD_RESET.
NOTE: not yet implemented — returns ErrInternal("not yet implemented").

RefreshSession extends the TTL of an unexpired session and updates
last_active_at in the DB. Sliding-window model: call from the API
gateway on each authenticated request, or periodically from clients.

Register creates a new user with email or phone, then opens a session.
Prerequisite: SendVerificationCode with purpose=REGISTER. Pass the
returned captcha_id back here alongside the code so the captcha library
binds verification to the same flow that generated it.
Returns: user + session_id (caller is now logged in).
Errors: ErrIdentityExists if email/phone already registered; ErrBadRequest
on missing/invalid/expired code.

SendVerificationCode generates a code, persists it in Redis (bound to
purpose+channel), and dispatches via message-service. Returns captcha_id
— pass it back to the consuming RPC (Register/Login/BindIdentity/...)
to bind code verification to the same flow (defense against cross-context
replay).
Caller provides ALL delivery content (template_id, sign_name, subject,
body, etc.) — user-service has no built-in templates. Use {code}
placeholder in body/subject for substitution.
Required fields depend on channel + region: see SendVerificationCodeRequest
for the CN vs international SMS path table.

get.summary:
ListIdentities returns every identity linked to a user (email, phone,
each OAuth provider, miniprogram openid, ...).

post.summary:
BindIdentity links a new email/phone identity to the current user.
Prerequisite: SendVerificationCode with purpose=BIND; pass captcha_id
in the request alongside the code.

BindOAuthIdentity links an OAuth provider identity (GitHub, Google,
WeChat web, Apple) to an already-authenticated user — the "绑定微信" /
"connect to GitHub" flow.
Prerequisite: GetOAuthURL (with the caller's session/user_id in mind) →
user authorizes on the provider → the OAuth callback service receives
code+state and calls BindOAuthIdentity. Does NOT create a session; the
caller is already logged in. Returns ErrIdentityExists if the provider
account is already linked (to this user or another).

delete.summary:
UnbindIdentity removes an identity. Requires user_id (the caller) and a
verification code as confirmation (prevents accidental lockout and
cross-user tampering — service rejects if identity.user_id != user_id).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The caller. The service refuses to delete when identity.user_id != user_id.

get.summary:
GetProfile returns the full profile of a user by ID. Caller is
responsible for authorization — the RPC does not verify that the
requester matches user_id.

put.summary:
UpdateProfile updates mutable profile fields. Empty fields are ignored
(partial update semantics). Read back via GetProfile.

post.summary:
ChangePassword verifies old_password and sets new_password.
Side effect: if the user is in PENDING_REVIEW status (e.g. created via
CreateUser), a successful change activates the account (status=ACTIVE).
This is the intended activation path for admin-created accounts.
Side effect: revokes every active session for the user (including the one
making this call) so the caller must re-authenticate with the new
password. Matches ResetPassword's behavior.

get.summary:
ListSessions returns active sessions for a user (for "manage devices" UIs).
Expired sessions are silently skipped. Sessions created by other services
using the same session store are included.

post.summary:
ExchangeSessionCode trades a one-time short code (issued by
IssueSessionCode) for session_id + user_id. Atomic one-time use
(GETDEL); replay returns ErrSessionInvalid. Business side sets its
own domain cookie from the returned session_id.

IssueSessionCode mints a one-time short code that references the given
session_id. Used by the OAuth callback service to hand the session back
to the business side via URL query without leaking session_id into
referer/logs/history. Business side calls ExchangeSessionCode within
~5 min to trade the code for session_id + user_id. One-time use.

RevokeAllSessions revokes every session for a user (logout everywhere).
Recommended after ChangePassword, ResetPassword, or DisableUser.

get.summary:
GetSession resolves a session_id to its user_id and metadata. Primary use
case: a BFF pulls session_id out of a cookie and needs user_id to inject
into downstream user-service RPCs. Read-only against Redis — does not
touch the DB. Side effect: like all session reads, slides the TTL forward
(same sliding-window semantics as RefreshSession).

post.summary:
RevokeSession revokes a specific session by ID (logout one device).
Caller is responsible for authorization.

SocialLogin completes a redirect-based OAuth flow. Called by the OAuth
callback service with the code+state the provider handed back. The
response carries the session_id AND the return_to that GetOAuthURL
recorded against this state — the callback service uses return_to to
302 the browser back to the originating business with the session.

MiniProgramLogin handles WeChat Mini Program login via wx.login() code.
Silent login identified by openid; no phone number is collected.
If you need phone, follow up with MiniProgramPhoneLogin — the existing
session is preserved and the phone identity is linked to the same user.

MiniProgramPhoneLogin exchanges wx.login() code AND getPhoneNumber code
for openid + phone. Requires both login_code (from wx.login) and
phone_code (from button bindgetphonenumber).
- Existing phone user: links miniprogram identity to that account.
- New user: registers with both phone and miniprogram identities.
response.is_new=true for newly registered accounts.

get.summary:
GetOAuthURL returns the OAuth authorization URL for redirect-based
providers (GitHub, Google, WeChat web, Apple). The URL embeds the
FIXED redirect URL configured at the provider (cfg.OAuth.{provider}.
RedirectURL) and a server-issued state. The caller only supplies
return_to: where the OAuth callback service should 302 the browser
AFTER user-service has minted a session. return_to must be on the
per-provider AllowedRedirectURLs allowlist.

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description:
return_to: where the OAuth callback service should send the browser
AFTER user-service has minted a session. Must be on the per-provider
AllowedRedirectURLs allowlist. This is NOT the URL registered with the
OAuth provider — that one is cfg.OAuth.{provider}.RedirectURL and is
fixed for the whole deployment.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
state: optional caller-supplied CSRF token (e.g. PKCE flows). When
empty, user-service generates one. Either way it ends up recorded
against this GetOAuthURL call so SocialLogin can confirm provenance.

userId.description:
The already-authenticated user to attach the OAuth identity to. The
gateway should fill this from the session token, not trust the client.

provider.title: OAuth only — EMAIL/PHONE go via BindIdentity

state.description:
state: required, must match what GetOAuthURL issued for this flow. Note
this RPC does NOT need return_to — the caller already has a session,
there's no post-OAuth browser redirect to worry about. state is here
purely for CSRF protection on the GetOAuthURL → BindOAuthIdentity path.

v1DeviceType.description:
DeviceType categorizes the client device for session and audit metadata.
Inferred at login time from request headers / user-agent by the API gateway
and passed through.

 - DEVICE_TYPE_API: Machine-to-machine / direct API token (no UA).

v1Gender.description:
Gender is the user's self-reported gender. Stored as-is; no business logic
branches on it.

url.description:
url: hand this to the browser as a 302 Location. It already encodes the
fixed provider RedirectURL and the recorded state — caller does not
need to add anything.

v1GetSessionResponse.description:
GetSessionResponse carries everything a BFF needs after resolving a
session_id: user_id is the primary field for downstream RPCs; expires_at is
derived from the Redis TTL at read time; created_at / ip / user_agent / os /
browser / login_method come from the Redis session payload (no DB read).
last_active_at is intentionally omitted — that field lives in the
user_sessions DB table and would force a DB lookup on every BFF request.

verified.description:
verified is true when the identity was bound via a flow that
cryptographically confirms control of the target (matching captcha code
for EMAIL/PHONE, successful ExchangeCode for OAuth, admin attestation for
ADMIN). user-service sets this to true at every write site; there is
currently no separate "click the verification link" flow that flips it
later — see UserIdentity.Verified godoc in internal/store/models for the
full contract.

v1IdentityProvider.description:
IdentityProvider identifies which login system a UserIdentity row belongs to.
Referenced by: Register.provider, BindIdentity.provider, SocialLogin.provider,
MiniProgramLogin (implicit WECHAT_MINIPROGRAM), and User.register_source.

Storage note: PHONE identities store ProviderUID as "<region_code>|<phone>"
(e.g. "CN|13800138000") so a single index covers region + local number.

ADMIN is not a real login method — it tags identities created by the
CreateUser RPC for audit purposes; Login never uses it.

 - IDENTITY_PROVIDER_WECHAT: WeChat web OAuth (redirect-based).
 - IDENTITY_PROVIDER_ADMIN: Audit tag for CreateUser; not a login method.

code.description:
code: 32 random bytes base64url-encoded (~43 chars). Pass via URL
query to the business side. TTL ~5 min, one-time use.

v1LoginAction.description:
LoginAction classifies an entry in the login audit log (UserLoginLog.action).
Set by user-service at login time — callers never pass this value.

 - LOGIN_ACTION_LOGIN: Successful password Login.
 - LOGIN_ACTION_REGISTER: Register RPC or code-login auto-register.
 - LOGIN_ACTION_SOCIAL_LOGIN: SocialLogin on an existing user.
 - LOGIN_ACTION_SOCIAL_REGISTER: SocialLogin / MiniProgramLogin on a new user.
 - LOGIN_ACTION_BIND: BindIdentity (planned).
 - LOGIN_ACTION_UNBIND: UnbindIdentity (planned).

v1LoginMethod.description:
LoginMethod is the authentication strategy for the Login RPC.
PASSWORD methods verify a stored bcrypt hash; CODE methods verify a one-time
code from SendVerificationCode(purpose=LOGIN) and auto-register when the
identity is missing (response.is_new=true).

 - LOGIN_METHOD_PHONE_CODE: Auto-registers on missing identity.
 - LOGIN_METHOD_EMAIL_CODE: Auto-registers on missing identity.

captchaId.description: captcha_id returned by SendVerificationCode; required for code-based login methods.

returnTo.description:
return_to is the business URL recorded against the OAuth state at
GetOAuthURL time. The OAuth callback service reads this and 302's the
browser there with the session token. Empty for non-OAuth login paths
(e.g. username+password).

v1Pong.description: Pong is the health-check response — only public, non-sensitive info.

captchaId.description: captcha_id returned by SendVerificationCode; required to verify the code.

senderId.description:
sender_id identifies the audit actor triggering this send (user ID,
service name, platform identifier, ...). Required: user-service is
stateless and passes this through to message-service verbatim — it does
not derive, transform, or default the value.

smsTemplateId.description:
SMS delivery — required when channel=SMS. Path is decided by destination
region (mirrors message-service's routing):
  - region_code == "CN" (domestic): sms_template_id + sms_code_param_key +
    sign_name are required. Domestic vendors reject raw content for
    regulatory reasons — every SMS must use a vendor pre-registered
    template. sms_code_param_key is the param-name under which the code is
    placed in template_params; the name is fixed at the vendor's template-
    registration time (e.g. "code", "param1", "verify_code") — caller must
    match it. Empty defaults to "code".
  - region_code != "CN" (international): caller picks ONE of
    sms_template_id (vendor that requires templates even for intl, e.g.
    Byteplus / Tencent-intl) OR sms_content (vendor that accepts raw
    text, e.g. Aliyun SendMessageToGlobe, Twilio).

{code} placeholder convention: sms_content may contain the literal
substring "{code}", which user-service replaces with the actual generated
code before forwarding to message-service. If sms_content does NOT
contain "{code}", the substitution is a no-op and the code is silently
dropped — caller's responsibility to include it.

emailSubject.description:
Email delivery — required when channel=EMAIL. email_subject and email_body
are always required; email_html_body is optional.

When email_html_body is set, message-service sends the email as MIME
multipart/alternative with both representations — HTML-capable clients
(Gmail, Outlook, mobile mail) render the pretty HTML; plain-text-only
clients (terminal mutt, some accessibility tools) fall back to email_body.
When email_html_body is empty, only the plain text body is sent.

All three fields may use the "{code}" placeholder convention (see
sms_content above): user-service replaces the literal substring "{code}"
with the actual code before forwarding. Missing "{code}" is a no-op —
the code is silently dropped. Typically only email_body / email_html_body
include it; subject rarely does (it's a header).

signName.description:
sign_name is the SMS signature passed through verbatim to message-service
when channel=SMS. Required for CN (domestic) SMS — domestic vendors reject
sends without it. Treated as sender ID for international SMS (vendor- and
region-specific semantics).

captchaId.description:
captcha_id must be passed back to Register/Login to bind code verification
to the same flow that generated it (defense against cross-context replay).

v1UserSortField.description:
UserSortField is the sort column for ListUsers / ListUsersPaged.
Default (UNSPECIFIED + descending=false) is equivalent to ID ascending.

 - USER_SORT_FIELD_ID: Default: snowflake id ascending.

v1UserStatus.description:
UserStatus is the account lifecycle state.
  - ACTIVE: account can log in (default after Register / SocialLogin / MiniProgramLogin).
  - DISABLED: account blocked; Login returns ErrUserDisabled.
  - PENDING_REVIEW: account created via CreateUser; user must call ChangePassword
    with the initial password to flip to ACTIVE before Login is accepted.

v1UserType.description:
UserType separates external end users from internal platform users
(staff, operations, ...). Set at creation time; not user-editable.

 - USER_TYPE_NORMAL: External end user (default).
 - USER_TYPE_INTERNAL: Platform internal user (staff, operations, etc.).

v1VerificationChannel.description:
VerificationChannel is the delivery channel for SendVerificationCode.
Decides which message-service API is called (SendEmail vs SendSMS) and which
template fields the request must supply.

v1VerificationPurpose.description:
VerificationPurpose binds a SendVerificationCode call to its consuming RPC,
preventing cross-context replay (e.g. a REGISTER code being reused to log in).
The (purpose, channel) pair must map to a valid scene in message-service —
e.g. VERIFY_PHONE on the EMAIL channel is rejected.

 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_REGISTER: Consumed by Register.
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_LOGIN: Consumed by Login (code methods).
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_VERIFY_EMAIL: EMAIL channel only.
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_VERIFY_PHONE: SMS channel only.
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_PASSWORD_RESET: Consumed by ResetPassword (TBD).
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_BIND: Consumed by BindIdentity (TBD).
